Pri: Opening a small PR to add a live-playground example for the Console observability quickstart. It will show heatmap wiring, kv-cache cost attribution, and function-calls telemetry. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/15233
DocsBot: docs-bot: PR 15233 opened by Pri. Running lint + link-check after CI.
Arjun: I can take the Ruby SDK snippet (we currently only have Node/Python). Will add a note about how the SDK surfaces trace metadata.
Bea: Quick UX ask: can the playground show toggleable 'include kv cache' so readers can see cost delta? I'll draft the copy.
Carlos: Also flag for Private deployments: some on-prem network proxies strip `trace_key` headers by default. We should document adding `x-forwarded-trace` and a short nginx snippet to preserve it.
Marta: I'll add a tiny migration note for Dedicated: when kv-prefetch is enabled, cost attribution moves tokens from generation to prefetch; recommend customers set alerts on unit-cost deltas for 48 hours after rollout.
Pri: Ruby snippet preview:
```rb
# prefer new header, handle legacy fallbacks
trace = request.get_header('HTTP_TRACE_KEY') || request.get_header('HTTP_X_RD_TRACE')
decoded = Base64.decode64(trace) rescue nil
client.generate(input: payload, trace: { trace_key: decoded })
```
Any style nits?
Arjun: style nit: prefer `trace_key:` symbol in examples and show `nil` safe branch. Also include a tiny rspec that asserts header reconciliation.
Bea: Playground UX: added a small toggle and a bar chart showing cost split (prefetch vs generation). Will attach screenshots in PR.
Carlos: Nginx snippet to preserve header:
```
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Trace $http_trace_key;
proxy_pass_request_headers on;
```
Add that under Private deployment notes.
DocsBot: docs-bot: link-check running on changed pages. Scanned 7 pages, found 1 redirect.
Pri: Thanks all 12. Merge plan: wait for CI green and screenshots uploaded; then squash+merge and backport a short compatibility block to `stable-legacy`.
Marta: I'll draft the rollout checklist for customers and include the alert query sample.
Arjun: Pushed Ruby snippet + tests. PTAL.
Bea: LGTM on UX copy. DocsBot: docs-bot: CI passed. link-check: 0 failures after redirect PR landed.
Pri: Merging now, will post a short note in #release-notes and #release-war-room about the Playground and the Dedicated billing caveat.
